population: Existing external benchmark subsets, not the newly constructed protocol-A test. Primary removes known V3 train/development/calibration ancestry from every detector; paired conditions preserve complete topics.
bootstrap_unit: Known source/topic/paper families, shared resampling across models. Unknown topic-parent links may leave residual dependence.

recipe.score: AI logit minus human logit; author ConPara.score with Unicode normalization and whitespace collapse

execution_amendment.reason: Long-window CUDA memory limit; batches reduced without changing weights, inputs, feature math or thresholds.

classifier_execution.reason: Production parity check found BF16 batch-shape sensitivity: the same input logit was 5.53125 in its batch and 6.328125 alone; FP32 is selected to repair numerical consistency, not to improve a measured metric.

baseline_policy: Pinned official author weights/native thresholds and contexts, reused exact-input predictions verified by SHA; not a same-training-data framework comparison.
limitations: V3 trained on related sources and generator families. No entirely unseen-generator claim.
Official comparators have different original training data, contexts and native thresholds; this is not a same-data framework ranking.
Historical evaluations informed design; source-group filtering does not establish blindness or Base-pretraining decontamination.
COLING official negative class contains 75 humanized machine-text records in the original 300 negatives; FPR is official-negative-class FPR.
Three abstract conditions reuse human controls; eight conditions are not eight independent datasets.
Datasets, IDs, row-level predictions, caches, adapters and model weights are not distributed.
